metadata.method: Exact maximal-chain dynamic programming on cyclic ideal height vectors, independently checked against stored n=4 polynomials.
metadata.arbitrary_k_claim: the supplied exact cubic recurrence defines the scalar sequence for all k>=2; the combinatorial values are independently checked through k=12

recurrence.status: recurrence for k>=5 with exact H2,H3,H4 boundary polynomials; the companion realization gives the scalar identity for every k>=2, and independent combinatorial checks pass through k=12

d4_mask_audit.observation: The natural D4-invariant function space on 16 masks has dimension 6. A 3-dimensional invariant subspace is possible but is not selected by orbit symmetry alone.

sixteen_state_operator.basis_description: D4 orbit-indicator vectors followed by within-orbit difference vectors
sixteen_state_operator.active_subspace: span of the first three D4 orbit-indicator vectors
sixteen_state_operator.interpretation: This is a noncanonical D4-equivariant algebraic embedding of the three-term recurrence. The 16 masks are not asserted to form a local Markov transfer.
sixteen_state_operator.identity_formula: u=e1^T*A^(-3), v=(H4,H3,H2)^T, H_k=u^T*A^(k-1)*v; recurrence used for k>=5

extremal_polynomial_and_spectrum.generic_spectral_decomposition: For distinct roots lambda_i of the cubic, H_k=sum_i c_i*lambda_i^(k-2), where for {i,j,l}={1,2,3}, c_i=(H4-(lambda_j+lambda_l)*H3+lambda_j*lambda_l*H2)/((lambda_i-lambda_j)*(lambda_i-lambda_l)); coalescing values are interpreted by limits.
extremal_polynomial_and_spectrum.discriminant_sign_on_I4: negative except at the two real roots of the sextic factor, where a pair of cubic modes coalesces; hence the generic cubic spectrum consists of one real root and one conjugate pair
extremal_polynomial_and_spectrum.spectral_branch_condition_for_all_k: the exact cubic spectral decomposition is available; a global all-k real-root interlacing proof is not established by this script

limitations: The 16x16 operator is the requested noncanonical D4-equivariant algebraic embedding of the companion recurrence, not a local Markov transfer or a combinatorial bijection on masks.
The arbitrary-k root-interlacing claim is not inferred from the finite root-isolation checks through k=12.
